The Agentic CX Suite for Retail
 
We help retailers achieve a unified customer view through AI-powered CRM, loyalty management, product discovery, and advertising to increase customer lifetime value.
 
 
Explore the CX Suite
 
View product tours

Trusted by 500+ retail brands
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 AI that understands the rhythms of retail 
 
 
 Drowning in data but not seeing the impact? Voyado's AI is built for retail and trained on real retail data, proactively acting on insights and suggesting your next best move. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Agentic Marketing
 
 Intelligent data, proactive insights and intent signals drives high-impact campaigns 
 
Learn more

 Personalization on every page turn your browsers into buyers 
 
Learn more

 Conversational and guided paths to purchase keep product discovery onsite

Connected experiences across channels
 
Omnichannel isn't a challenge, it's an opportunity. Unite sales and marketing touchpoints to drive store traffic, increase conversions and grow customer lifetime value.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Email marketing
 
 
 
 
 
Create highly relevant emails powered by real-time customer data, AI-driven content, and automated journeys that adapt to each shopper’s behavior. At scale and across markets.
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SMS/RCS
 
 
 
 
 
Reach customers instantly with timely, personalized messages that cut through the noise. From order updates to offers that drive immediate action and store or online visits.
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Search and browse
 
 
 
 
 
Help shoppers find exactly what they’re looking for with AI-powered search and navigation that understands intent, product context, and business priorities in every moment.
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Onsite messaging
 
 
 
 
 
Guide shoppers in real time with personalized messages across the site. From nudges and reminders to offers and content that increase conversion without disrupting the experience.
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Recommendations
 
 
 
 
 
Serve spot-on product recommendations based on shopper intent, product performance, and retail context. Turning inspiration into higher conversion and basket size.
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Advertising
 
 
 
 
 
By syncing real-time customer segments to channels like Meta, Google and TikTok, you can create high-performing lookalike audiences and precision re-targeting.
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
In-store
 
 
 
 
 
Connect insights to the physical store with personalized offers, loyalty interactions, and recommendations that make every visit feel relevant and rewarding.
 
 Learn more 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Digital wallet
 
 
 
 
 
Keep your brand top of mind by delivering loyalty cards, offers, and rewards directly to customers’ mobile wallets. Always accessible, always up to date.
 
 Learn more

 Search 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Priced for retail.
Not everyone.
 
Voyado pricing has two parts: a fixed platform fee and a usage-based fee that scales with your business. This applies across our two products, allowing you to tailor the setup to your specific needs. No fixed tiers or one-size-fits-all packages. We build the right setup around your goals. Talk to our team and we’ll put together a clear proposal.
 
 
 
 
 
Our products
 
 
 
 
Customer Engagement
 
 
 
 
How it's priced
 
Fixed platform fee plus volume-based pricing for email, SMS, and other channels. Our customers see an average 8% increase in purchase frequency.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Agentic omnichannel marketing
 
 
 
 
 
 
Multi-market efficiency
 
 
 
 
 
 
Native loyalty management that grows CLV
 
 
 
Talk to sales
 
 
 
 
Key Features: 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Unified customer profiles
 
 
Every interaction, channel, and purchase in one profile. Segment by behavior, CLV, purchase history, and more to reach exactly the right person at exactly the right moment.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Agentic campaign automation 
 
 
Campaigns that trigger, adapt, and optimize based on what shoppers actually do. Powered by Bonnie, Voyado’s retail-trained AI, across email, SMS, and every channel you run.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Native loyalty management
 
 
Points, incentives, and gamified challenges built into your CRM and not integrated from a third-party tool. Loyalty data flows directly into every campaign and customer profile.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Omnichannel and in-store
 
 
Online and in-store data unified in one place. Your campaigns reflect how customers actually shop and not just what they do when they’re browsing from home.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Insights and reports
 
 
CLV, churn risk, RFM, and revenue attribution in clean dashboards. A clear line between your marketing activities and business outcomes — not just open rates.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
"Voyado provided us with the perfect all-in-one solution"
 
Carlijn Masteling, Online Content Marketer at Dille & Kamille.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Product Discovery
 
 
 
 
How it's priced
 
Fixed platform fee plus volume-based pricing based on monthly sessions and catalog size. Our customers see an average 15–20% conversion uplift.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Retail-trained AI search
 
 
 
 
 
 
Relevance and personalization
 
 
 
 
 
 
Automated merchandising
 
 
 
Talk to sales
 
 
 
 
Key Features: 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Retail-native search
 
 
Search that understands your catalog the way a merchandiser does. Typo tolerance, synonym handling, color and image detection. Personalized results for every shopper.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI recommendations
 
 
The right product, in front of the right shopper, at the right moment. Upsell, alternatives, and “style with” suggestions that are adjustable to your merchandising rules.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Algorithmic merchandising
 
 
Product placement that acts on trend signals, lifecycle data, and performance automatically. Your team sets the strategy. AI handles the execution.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Connected recommendations
 
 
Personalization that follows shoppers beyond search to product pages, cart, email, and every touchpoint in between.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Insights and reports
 
 
Search performance, click-through, zero-result rates, and revenue impact in dashboards built for merchandisers and e-com teams, not data analysts.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
"We can basically just lean back and watch how the Voyado algorithms and automation ensure that the best-selling products instantly receive the highest ranking after setting it up."
 
Petter Forsman, Digital Visual Merchandiser & Art Director at MQ
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Start with one. Both is where results compound.
 
 
When Customer Engagement and Product Discovery share data, the shopper browsing your site and the customer in your CRM are finally the same person. Campaigns get sharper. Recommendations get smarter. CLV grows faster.

Any doubts? 
 We're here to help
 
 
 
 
 
 
How does Voyado pricing work?
 
 
Voyado is a SaaS subscription, and we don’t publish fixed list prices.The right setup depends on your business. Pricing is based on the products you adopt, the scale of your operation, and the markets you serve. Contact our team and we’ll put together a tailored proposal. You’ll always know what you’re paying for and why.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Do I need to buy the full suite, or can I start with one product?
 
 
You can start with whichever product fits your most immediate need. Many retailers begin with Customer Engagement to unify their CRM, loyalty, and campaigns. Others start with Product Discovery to lift on-site conversion. Each product is best-of-breed on its own and significantly more powerful when they share the same data layer. Most customers expand over time as they see results compound.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What size of retailer is Voyado built for?
 
 
Voyado is purpose-built for mid-market and enterprise omnichannel retailers. Typically brands with significant e-commerce volume, physical stores, and ambitions to grow across markets. We work with 500+ retail brands across 100 markets, including H&M Group, Kicks, Björn Borg, and Nudie Jeans. If you’re outgrowing generic tools or managing loyalty and CRM at scale, you’re likely a strong fit.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
How is Voyado different from other CRM and search platforms?
 
 
Most platforms are built for every industry and adapted for retail. Voyado is built only for retail. Every AI model, data structure, and feature is designed around how retailers actually operate: seasonal campaigns, SKU-level product data, loyalty mechanics, and omnichannel complexity. Our AI agent, Bonnie, is trained on real retail consumer behavior, not a generic model repurposed for e-commerce. That difference shows up in the results.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
How long does it take to get up and running?
 
 
Implementation timelines depend on your setup and the products you adopt, but most customers see value in weeks rather than months. Voyado integrates with the tools you already use; major e-commerce platforms, POS systems, payment providers, and ad channels including Meta, Google, and TikTok. Our onboarding team and certified implementation partners are with you from day one.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What does Agentic AI actually mean in practice?
 
 
In Voyado, you’ll find Bonnie AI, an retail-trained agent thats embedded directly into the platform and connected to purchase, in-store, and loyalty data. It uses real-time behavioral signals to identify and execute next-best actions across marketing, CRM, and loyalty workflows.
By operating within your existing data, context, and business logic, Bonnie ensures that insights and recommendations are based on actual customer behavior. Not generic models. This enables more relevant interactions, improved efficiency, and stronger customer lifetime value across the entire customer journey.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Does Voyado integrate with my existing tech stack?
 
 
Yes. Voyado connects with the tools retailers already rely on; e-commerce platforms, POS systems, ad channels, and more. You can explore our full integration ecosystem at connect.voyado.com. During discovery, our team will assess your current stack to make sure everything connects cleanly before you sign anything.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
How do I know if Voyado is right for us?
 
 
The best way to find out is a conversation with one of our retail specialists. We’ll look at your current setup, your goals, and show you how retailers similar to yours are using Voyado today. No pressure, no generic demo, just a straight answer on whether it’s the right fit.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
“Voyado is the engine behind all the different phases and communication within the customer journey.”
Claudia Moron, Head of eCommerce at Love Stories
